label: operational comparison on historical (unreviewed) and fresh (reference-free) material; teacher quality requires independent judgments

recipe.lora_targets: q, k, v, o of every T5 attention block (encoder self, decoder self, decoder cross)
recipe.schedule: linear warm-up, then linear decay to 0 at max_updates
recipe.select: greedy exact-match macro on E03 dev primary items; ties: lower train-val loss, then earlier update

gate.needs: independent judgments (data/e06/review/judgments.tsv by a reviewer who is not a model or the agent) on the blinded queue
gate.unit: primary-track pool word; a system's top-1 is accepted if judged acceptable ('uncertain' = not accepted; sensitivity: uncertain = accepted)
gate.comparison: paired: reference (byt5_lora) top-1 accepted − baseline (default_e02) top-1 accepted, per word
gate.interval: family bootstrap (pool words are one family each), 10,000 resamples, seed 20261027, 95% percentile
pass_if: reference accepted count > baseline accepted count
net advantage not confined: positive difference in at least 3 categories and no category supplies more than half of the net wins
malformed, translations (judged comments) and unsupported cases reported
gate.otherwise: teacher_advantage_unresolved (insufficient sample or interval) or teacher_not_better
